name: HBL Engineering Limited
summary: HBL Engineering Limited manufactures and sells batteries and electronic equipment in India and internationally. It operates through Industrial batteries, Defense and Aviation batteries, and Electronics segments. The company offers lead acid batteries, nickel-cadmium batteries, silver zinc batteries, and lithium batteries. It also provides rail signaling electronics, electronic fuzes for ammunition, train collision avoidance systems, train management system, and electric drive trains. The company serves system integrators, EPC's, railway, aviation, and defense companies, as well as government sector.
